prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a rear-end collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1416; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- A few old scratches may be older than this crash.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked across the center and the left tail lamp assembly is broken, with the trunk lid showing deformation along its lower edge. The damage pattern is consistent with the reported impact direction and height. The plan calls for replacing the bumper cover, tail lamp, and trunk panel, with refinishing and a pre-scan of the rear sensors. Labor hours fit the extent of the damage shown. A few light scratches on the right quarter panel appear older than this loss and have been noted separately. Two similar charges posted to the file on the same day are under review before payment is released.
